note.sourcePages: Original practice material written around common GCSE-style language themes; not official exam-board material.
note.summary:
3.2 Media and technology
Key focus
- social media, online safety, devices, communication and digital habits.

Core language
- Useful structures: secondo me; penso che; mi piace perché; l’anno scorso; in futuro; di solito; dovrei/dovremmo.
- Use negatives carefully, give advantages and drawbacks, and distinguish direct speech from reported opinions.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: I use my phone to talk to friends and check timetables.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Uso il telefono per parlare con i miei amici e controllare gli orari.”

Give two uses of the phone.

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: My sister spends three hours a day on social media, perhaps too much.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Mia sorella trascorre tre ore al giorno sui social, forse troppe.”

How much time does the sister spend online, and what is implied?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: Yesterday I downloaded an app that helps me learn vocabulary.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Ieri ho scaricato un’app che mi aiuta a imparare il vocabolario.”

What was downloaded, and how is it useful?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: I never post photos of my home in order to protect my privacy.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Non pubblico mai foto della mia casa per proteggere la mia privacy.”

What does the speaker never do, and why?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: A video call is convenient, but it does not replace a real visit.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Una videochiamata è comoda, ma non sostituisce una visita reale.”

What is an advantage and limitation of video calls?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: Tomorrow I will change my password and update all my programs.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Domani cambierò la mia password e aggiornerò tutti i programmi.”

Name the two online-safety actions planned for tomorrow.
